## Benchmark authorship and display credit

- I ran these benchmarks myself: yes / no (if no, identify the runner with their permission).
- Benchmark author display: chosen name / GitHub handle / Anonymous contributor.
- Optional public links chosen by the author: GitHub, LinkedIn, X, website.
- I confirm the named author agreed to this credit and these links: yes / not yet.

Maintainers record confirmed credit in `submission-credits.json` after the PR
has a URL. Submission authorship is separate from who measured the benchmark.
Anonymous display hides the name and links on the website; the public source PR
and Git history remain accessible. Omit personal details you do not want public.

Measurements are contributor-reported. Acceptance checks format and protocol
consistency; it does not certify independent reproduction of the results.
